snippet.title: Wheelmates Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist here - store.steampowered.com/app/3905450

Like It Takes Two on wheels, Wheelmates has you exploring a mysterious laboratory as a pair of dinky RC cars, solving puzzles and overcoming platforming challenges along the way. A new gameplay trailer provided a window into its supersized world, alongside the news that it's coming to PC on September 7, later this year.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
